title: Machine-Checked Exact-Rational Anchor Robustness, Hall-Matching, and Contiguous Allocation Certificates for Five-Agent Envy-Free Cake Cutting
abstract: Filos-Ratsikas, Hollender, Latifian, and Tyrovolas (arXiv:2611.33149, November 24, 2026) resolved the longstanding five-agent contiguous eps-envy-free cake-cutting problem in O(log^3(1/eps)) value queries using a four-piece anchor decomposition, delta-robust Hall matchings on the bipartite favourite graph G_delta(m, ell), spanning-tree bisection, and a gamma-strongly-hungry valuation reduction. We present a machine-checked, zero-floating-point formalization and certificate auditing architecture for the combinatorial, geometric, and algebraic core of this protocol. First, we build an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel (EnvyFreeFiveAgents.lean, Lean 4.35.0; 0 sorry, 0 warnings, 0 Classical.choice, 4 zero-axiom theorems) certifying anchor length conservation and gap closure, Lemma 3.7/3.9 balanced weights and strict Hall-ceiling margins 9p - 8 > 8(p-1) (p in {1,2,3,4}), Lemma 3.5 connectivity contradiction, K_{5,4} spanning-tree count 5^3 * 4^4 = 32,000, Theorem 2 gamma-strong-hungriness perturbation and (delta + 2*gamma) envy transfer, Lemma 4.2 3*delta-robust maximality extension, Lemma 4.4 complete eps-envy-freeness, five-agent proportionality, inductive list envy transfer, and the exact polylog separation b^3 < 2^b for all b >= 10. Second, we define ENVY-FREE-5-CERT-1.0 and a pure-stdlib zero-float verifier covering four audit modes: maximal delta-robust anchor + Hall + spanning-tree certificates, complete contiguous 5-agent eps-EF divisions, gamma-strongly-hungry transfers on non-hungry zero-density instances, and Lemma 3.9 balanced-weight / query-barrier witnesses. Across 16 canonical certificates spanning four heterogeneous valuation benchmarks, zero-float replay runs in 0.115-1.020 ms, passes independent midpoint-integration and proportionality cross-checks, and rejects 54/54 live adversarial forgeries.
